title: Trump threatens Iranian infrastructure over Strait of Hormuz attacks
facts: US President Donald Trump warned that the US would destroy one Iranian bridge or power plant for each attack on a ship in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi announced that Iran would adopt an 'eye for an eye' defence doctrine.
United States Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth estimated in a Senate hearing that the US had spent $37.5 billion on the war.
Benchmark Brent crude oil rose to over $93 per barrel following the escalating tensions.
Jordan's military intercepted four Iranian missiles and four Iranian drones over the city of Aqaba.
Two Iranian missiles landed in uninhabited areas near Aqaba.
Saudi Arabian authorities issued an alert warning residents of Dammam to seek shelter.
Iran's Health Ministry reported that US strikes over 11 days killed 53 people, including six women and three children.
Iran's Health Ministry reported nearly 600 people wounded by US strikes over an 11-day period.
Iranian Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni visited Pakistan to engage in diplomatic mediation.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio attended a regional summit in the Philippines.
The United States reimposed a naval blockade on Iranian ports in response to attacks in the Strait of Hormuz.
The Pickaxe Mountain under-construction Iranian nuclear site is located south of the Natanz enrichment facility.
The United States bombed Iran's Natanz enrichment facility during a 12-day war in 2025.
One-fifth of globally traded oil and gas passed through the Strait of Hormuz during peacetime.
